Frequently Asked Questions

How much do table rentals cost?
6 ft rectangular folding tables are available by request starting at $8 each. Final quantity, availability, and pricing are confirmed manually.
Can I rent tables alone?
Yes. Standalone table rentals are available by quote, with a minimum rental order before travel. Tables can also be added to inflatables, tents, 360 Video Booth bookings, packages, and lawn games.
Do you deliver tables?
Yes. The first 15 km from Bridgewater is free, then $0.72/km. Delivery, quantity, and final pricing are confirmed manually based on your date, location, and order size.
What are 6 ft tables good for?
Food and serving tables, seating, registration and welcome tables, prize tables, and vendor tables at birthdays, school events, community events, and markets.
